parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, located on the tank of the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Lid)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic lid that covers the top of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted off for maintenance but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a cover for hygiene and aesthetic purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring that provides a comfortable sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user while sitting and provides ergonomic comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge for cleaning or covering.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water, supports the seat, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
